title: "Sites built with it"

*Written for version 0.1.14.*

## The reference site

- [Cryptococcus-cost-analysis](https://vagishhemmige.github.io/Cryptococcus-cost-analysis): the site the plugin's starter follows. It was built before the plugin and has since been brought in line with it, so it shows the layout a project site gets: background pages, Study design and methods, one page per script, and the project documents. [Repository](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/Cryptococcus-cost-analysis).

## Sites built with the plugin from the start

None are listed yet. If you have built one, open an [issue on the plugin's repository](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/issues) with its address.

To see what a project site looks like before then, the plugin's [starter files](https://github.com/VagishHemmige/r-analysis-workflow/tree/main/plugin/assets/starter) hold a small example site with made-up code.
